51535228.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to C-terminal 6-His tagged ENL YEATS domain (1 to 148 residues) (unknown origin) expressed in Escherichia coli BL21 cells assessed as dissociation constant by SPR assay

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods - Surface plasmon: Surface plasmon resonance assays were performed to test the binding affinity of ENL protein or GAS41 protein and the compounds on a Biacore T200 instrument (GE Healthcare) with HBS buffer (20 mM HEPES pH 7.4, 200 mM NaCl, 0.1% (v/v) DMSO) at 25 °C. The protein was immobilized on a CM5 chip (GE Healthcare) using a standard amine-coupling procedure in 10 mM sodium acetate (pH 4.5). The chip was then equilibrated in HBS buffer overnight. The compounds were serially dissolved with HBS buffer. For each cycle, compound solution was injected for 150 s, followed by a 180 s delay for dissociation. The Kd values of the analyzed compounds were determined by Biacore T200 evaluation software (GE Healthcare).
original_paragraph.Figure 4 caption: Fig. 4. SPR assays of the binding between ENL and the inhibitors. The concentrations of the different compounds injected over the CM5 chip are indicated, and the SPR curves for these inhibitors binding with ENL are shown. (A) The value of Kd for SGC-iMLLT binding with ENL was 24.5 nM. (B) The value of Kd for compound 28 binding with ENL was 17.0 nM.
